title: Deeper/broader uncad DXF route and acad-ts lineage readiness review
scope: Separate newly surfaced parser, projection, and converter routes by actual implementation lineage
Assess whether uncad/undxf can fill an existing independent DXF-reader comparator gap
Identify route-specific omissions and diagnostic settings that could invalidate apparent parity
Update the existing optional composed checkpoint without adding per-slice validation

method.kind: Read-only review of current public primary-source repositories and local plan
method.limitations: Repository documentation and project-reported corpus counts are not independently reproduced conformance evidence. uncad main, acad-ts master, and dwg-reader main are mutable references; no immutable source pin or package/source reconciliation was performed.

sources.observed: The README describes uncad as read-only, states DWG uses LibreDWG through FFI and DXF ASCII/Binary uses the separate pure-Rust undxf reader, and says the vendored LibreDWG copy has local patches. The workspace license is GPL-3.0-or-later.

The caveats report 66/67 DXFs from the LibreDWG test corpus parsed and all 32 R2007+ examples parsed; these are project-reported, not independently reproduced. The same document says 3DSOLID/REGION use isometric wireframes rather than B-rep reads; eight listed families are experimental and none were exercised by real drawings; a DWG TABLE arrives as unknown because its LibreDWG decode is debug-class only, while the DXF TABLE path is separate.

sources.revision: Mutable master reviewed 2026-10-17; README names ACadSharp base commit 3010994939c1bc21df0c9e2931e9baee4564815a and last compared commit 3feabba4b2cbcb226f10b288aaee32442b03af6f
sources.observed: The project describes itself as a TypeScript port of ACadSharp, providing explicit parser lineage rather than an independent DWG/DXF implementation.

The reader docs say DWG is supported from AC1014 to AC1032 and DXF ASCII/Binary from AC1009 to AC1032. They document failsafe=true, keepUnknownEntities=false, and keepUnknownNonGraphicalObjects=false as defaults, so a permissive default read may recover or omit content.

sources.revision: Mutable master reviewed 2026-10-17; package version 3.2.0, MIT
sources.observed: The npm package is MIT and exposes build/typecheck/lint/test scripts. Package metadata does not create an independent parser lineage from its stated ACadSharp port.

The README says DXF is read directly, while DWG requires an installed ODA File Converter or LibreDWG dwg2dxf; downstream extraction and preview use ezdxf/matplotlib. This is an orchestration pipeline, not a new native DWG parser.

The plan already separates parser lineage, carrier preservation, semantic geometry, and native-consumer gates and keeps peer work at the composed checkpoint. This research adds a possible undxf DXF-only route row but no new support finding or required implementation task.

assessment.uncadDwg: LIBREDWG_LINEAGE; do not count as an independent DWG reader. The shared model, twin corpus, and project-reported coverage figures are not independent expected truth.
assessment.uncadDxf: undxf is a candidate independent ASCII/Binary DXF structural reader, pending exact source/lockfile pin, source and license audit, and small independently authored field manifest at the optional composed checkpoint. Do not use the renderer as 3D semantic evidence.
assessment.acadTs: ACadSharp-derived parser lineage. At most an optional packaging/runtime consumer route; strict comparator use must pin the route, disable failsafe, retain unknown entities/non-graphical objects, and capture diagnostics.
assessment.converterWrappers: Converter plus downstream-parser pipelines, not independent DWG parser votes. Attribute results to every selected stage and exact artifact.
assessment.threeDSemantics: No evidence closes ACIS/AcDs ownership, full SAT/SAB interpretation, B-rep validity, or native Linux/Windows FreeCAD acceptance.
